$comment: Per-token Anthropic pricing used for session cost estimation. Patterns are case-insensitive regexes tested (in order, first match wins) against the normalized model name (lowercased, 'claude ' prefix stripped, separators collapsed to single spaces — e.g. 'eu.anthropic.claude-opus-4-6-v1' becomes 'opus 4 6'). More specific model lines MUST come before broader fallbacks. Pricing matches Bedrock/Vertex and direct Anthropic API (identical per-token rates). Users can extend or override these via config.display.pricingOverrides, which are matched before this list.
